## Complete List of Competitor Product Demo URLs

After searching all five data sources (urls, slack, meeting_transcripts, meeting_chats, documents), I found exactly **3 competitor product demo URLs**:

| # | URL | Competitor Product | Source(s) |
|---|-----|--------------------|-----------|
| 1 | `https://personaai.com/demo` | **PersonaAI** | URLs section (line 17128), Slack message (line 1219) |

### Details by Source

**URLs section:** All three competitor demo URLs appear with explicit descriptions confirming they are competitor demos:
- `"A demo showing how PersonaAI works."`
- `"A demo showing how SmartSuggest works."`
- `"A demo showing how TailorAI works."`

**Slack messages:** Each was shared by a team member in project channels:
- PersonaAI demo shared by user `eid_5318af37` on 2026-06-13 in `#planning-PersonalizeForce`: `"@here take a look at PersonaAI--demo available here https://personaai.com/demo"`

**Meeting transcripts:** No competitor demo URLs were found. The 8 meeting transcripts are all sprint review/product planning meetings focused on internal PersonalizeForce development tasks.

**Meeting chats:** The `meeting_chats` section is empty (`[]`).

**Documents:** No competitor demo URLs were found. The documents are internal market research reports, product vision documents, product requirements documents, technical specifications, and system design documents. While they discuss competitors like Salesforce, Adobe, and IBM at a high level, they do not contain any demo URLs.
